project.name: SpatialDebugger
project.what: Meta Quest 3 mixed-reality tool for debugging physical electronics. Point at a wire on a breadboard, ask, and the answer appears anchored in space next to the hardware.
project.nested_repo_warning: Unity/.git is a SEPARATE repo pointing at YheChen/Unity.git. All work goes in the OUTER repo at SpatialDebugger/. Committing from inside Unity/ hits the wrong repository.
project.push_status: NOT pushed. Local commits only, as instructed.

environment.meta_xr_sdk: v205.0.0 (core, interaction, interaction.ovr, platform, haptics, voice) + MRUK v205
environment.other_packages: com.unity.xr.openxr 1.18.0 (ADDED overnight), xr.management 4.7.0, xr.hands 1.9.0, URP 17.6.0, newtonsoft-json 3.2.2
environment.input: Input System package ONLY (activeInputHandler: 1). UnityEngine.Input throws at runtime.
environment.android: IL2CPP + ARM64, minSdk 32, targetSdk 34, package com.htn2026.spatialdebugger. SDK/NDK/JDK all bundled with the editor, no overrides.
environment.python: uv-managed venv at backend/.venv on CPython 3.13

verification_loop.why: The user's Unity Editor was open on the project all night, and two Unity processes cannot share a project path.
verification_loop.how: APFS clone of Unity/ into the scratchpad (cp -Rc, ~8s, copy-on-write so it costs no disk), source rsynced in before each run, batch-mode Unity run against the clone.
verification_loop.script: scratchpad/unity-compile.sh (throwaway, not in the repo; recipe is in CLAUDE_PROGRESS.md)
verification_loop.note: The compile script rsyncs Assets/Packages/ProjectSettings from the real project with --delete, EXCLUDING generated artefacts (Assets/XR, Assets/Scenes, Assets/TextMesh Pro, Assets/SpatialDebugger/Resources).

blockers_found_and_fixed: No XR plug-in was installed at all. Meta XR v205 ships no XR loader; it is an OpenXR *feature* gated on USING_XR_SDK_OPENXR. The APK would have launched as a flat 2D Android app.

Gradle failed on duplicate libopenxr_loader.so. Meta's hook that disables Unity's copy resolves MetaXRFeature via FeatureHelpers.GetFeatureWithIdForBuildTarget, OpenXR settings held two instances, and the resolved one was disabled.

OVRManifestPreprocessor.GenerateManifestForSubmission() silently no-ops in batch mode (DisplayDialog returns false), so the manifest had no hand-tracking, scene or anchor permissions while reporting success.
next_steps_in_order: Run the MORNING CHECKLIST in CLAUDE_PROGRESS.md. Steps 1-3 need no headset and take about 6 minutes.
In Play mode, click the stand-in breadboard then press Demo Analysis. That exercises the entire pipeline on a Mac.

Sideload Unity/Build/Android/SpatialDebugger.apk (adb install -r) and work down the on-device list in order: does it enter XR, is passthrough on, is hand tracking on in the headset's own settings, does the panel appear, can you pinch a button, does Target In Front + Demo Analysis draw annotations, then finally does pointing land where you expect.
If the ray is offset, tune MetaHandPointerSource.requireHighConfidence and SpatialRaycaster.fallbackDistance.
If annotations are the wrong size, change annotationScale on Assets/SpatialDebugger/Resources/SpatialDebuggerConfig.asset.
Optional: Window > TextMeshPro > Import TMP Essential Resources for nicer text, then re-run Configure Project.
gotchas: Meta XR v205 ships NO XRLoader. com.unity.xr.oculus is deprecated on this editor; OpenXR 1.18.0 is the bundled, supported choice.
OVRHand.HandType is internal to Oculus.VR. Handedness must be set through SerializedObject.
OVRProjectConfig lives in an Editor-only assembly; runtime code cannot reference it.
Building Block prefabs live under Editor/ folders and are stripped from player builds. Use Prefabs/OVRCameraRig.prefab and Prefabs/OVRHandPrefab.prefab.
EnvironmentRaycastManager is in namespace Meta.XR (not Meta.XR.MRUtilityKit) and its IsReady is private; check EnvironmentRaycastHit.status instead.
MRUK's RaycastHit has no collider populated.
Passthrough needs the centre-eye camera to clear to a fully transparent colour under URP. Getting it wrong shows a black void, and it looks fine in the Editor.
Shaders from 'Library/unity default resources' (e.g. GUI/Text Shader) carry HideFlags.DontSave and fail the player build if added to Always Included Shaders.
TMP Essential Resources cannot be imported from batch mode with -quit; both import APIs are async and get torn down. SpatialText falls back to legacy TextMesh so text still renders.
-quit makes a failed BuildPipeline.BuildPlayer exit 0; SpatialDebuggerBuild calls EditorApplication.Exit(1) itself.
Compile errors never reach BuildReport: -executeMethod is simply never called.
